$Comment: Life essence the Sawmill shook loose, rung 1 of the sawmill_essence ladder. An exact item id, so only the plain essence counts here; the concentrated form has its own achievement. One rung of a ladder: Listing.Chains names the ladder and this rung's place in it, and every rung shares ONE FlavorKey whose {0} is filled from TextArgs.Flavor's @amount, so retuning a rung is editing its Amount and nothing in a language file. Every STATION_OUTPUT criterion carries Qualifier 'Sawmill', so only what this station hands over counts.
Name: Sawmill_Essence_T1
